spans.s: Vāgulī (EI 28), Od̤iyā; also written Bāgulī; the king's betel-bearer; same as Vārgulika, etc.
Vāgulika, Vāgūlika (CII 4; BL), explained by some as ‘a seller of betel-leaves’; the bearer of the betel-box of an Orissan ruler; same as Vārgulika, etc.
vagainda-kāśu (SITI), Tamil; tax payable in cash for marking the details, as of land; fees for subdivision of land; also the fee for settlement, as of a dispute.
vagainda-kāśu , name of a tax; see kāśu.
